sloka: स बाणजालान्यथ तानि तानि मोघानि पश्यं स्त्रिदशारिराजः ।विसिष्मिये लक्ष्मणलाघवेन पुनश्च बाणान्निशितान् मुमोच ।। ६.५९.१०२ ।।।।
transliteration: sa bāṇajālānyatha tāni tāni moghāni paśyaṁ stridaśārirājaḥ ।visiṣmiye lakṣmaṇalāghavena punaśca bāṇānniśitān mumoca ।। 6.59.102 ।।।।

translations.english: The brother of Rama stretched his bow into a circle and showered rain of piercing arrows. He tore the arrows of his enemy with his arrows Kshura, Ardhachandra, karni and Balan without nay, perturbance.
